LanguageData.TT_ModsToGroup: Buttons from mods go into the group "{0}"
LanguageData.TT_ModsToGroupTip: The game's own buttons stay on the bar; every button added by a mod goes into one group button that opens a menu. You can still put any of them back on the bar or into your own groups.
LanguageData.TT_AutoMove: Move buttons that don't fit into "More"
LanguageData.TT_AutoMoveTip: When the bar is full, the last buttons go into the "More" menu instead of being squeezed until their labels are cut.
LanguageData.TT_IconsSmall: Buttons with an icon show only the icon
LanguageData.TT_IconsSmallTip: A button that has an icon takes only the icon's width; its name is in the tooltip. Leaves more room for the others.
LanguageData.TT_Hint: Right click a button on the bar to move it into a group or back. Right click a group to sort its buttons. Hotkeys work everywhere.
LanguageData.TT_TidyAlertsTip: The same alert many times (one per animal …) is shown once with ×N. Critical and high alerts always show, the others up to the limit – the rest is folded into "+N more". Right click an alert to hide it for a day or for good.
LanguageData.TT_AlertLimit: Alerts shown at most: {0} (critical and high always)
LanguageData.TT_AlertHideDay: Hide this alert for a day
LanguageData.TT_LetterDays: Letters go away by themselves after {0} days
LanguageData.TT_LetterDaysOff: Letters go away by themselves: never
LanguageData.TT_LetterDaysTip: Only letters you could dismiss yourself with a right click. Quest offers waiting for an answer stay. Every letter is still in the History tab.
LanguageData.TT_LetterMax: At most {0} letters on the stack
LanguageData.TT_LetterMaxOff: Letters on the stack: no limit
LanguageData.TT_LetterMaxTip: When there are more, the oldest ones that could be dismissed go away (they stay in the History tab).
LanguageData.TT_CollapsePlay: Play settings icons behind one button
LanguageData.TT_CollapsePlayTip: The icons above the time controls (zones, roofs, beauty, temperature …, also those of mods) are behind one button that opens them in a small window. Their hotkeys keep working.
